method_note: IROS 2026 (Pittsburgh, 27 Sep–1 Oct 2026). The program guide lists 160 Focused Sessions and 188 Lightning-Talk sessions, but their titles are free-form descriptive phrases (e.g. 'Aerial Grasping and Perching', 'Architectural Advances in Vision-Language-Action Models') rather than keyword-named sessions, so a session-level tally would require subjective title-by-title coding. Instead counted: the FIRST (primary) IEEE RAS keyword of all 1929 papers in the official Paper Index (every paper carries keywords). The same hand-made RAS-keyword→taxonomy mapping as for ICRA 2026 was used (1 id or 50/50 split across 2); 41 papers with no taxonomy fit were excluded, leaving 1888. Papers whose title matches VLA/VLM/LLM/vision-language/language model/foundation model (158) are split 0.5 foundation-models + 0.5 keyword topic. Weights = paper-equivalents / 1888; ids below 0.02 omitted (space-robotics 0.005 = 9 paper-equivalents, phm, education). Mapping is the dataset author's judgement.
